name: TrustReady Benchmark v1
thesis: Can TrustReady resolve who has authority, what can execute, what effect can happen, and what evidence supports the release decision across structurally different real repositories?

targets.proofShape: request authority → agent → tools → deterministic boundary → effect sink → native adversarial evidence
multiple agent entrypoints → scoped tool ownership → deterministic non-agent surfaces → declarative authority contracts
CLI authority → guarded action → process/network effect → human release gate

truthBoundary: Benchmark GO means the named target and scoped surfaces satisfy the benchmark assertions at the scanned commit. It is not a repository-wide security certification, does not prove dynamic completeness, and does not certify business correctness or remote-service enforcement.
